title: 再起動後バックグラウンドで起動しないwindows11 64bit

judgment.rationale: Existing diagnostics do not establish that automatic startup was enabled before the failed reboot. Confirm the visible setting and whether it persists before selecting a task-registration or settings-persistence fix.
evidence: The Japanese report describes no background startup after restarting Windows 11 x64.
A diagnostic ZIP is already attached; version and installation source are supplied.
The public report does not say whether Run at startup was enabled or remained enabled after reboot.
Runner general settings derive the displayed startup state from the scheduled task and apply startup changes through task creation/deletion, with policy overrides.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether Run at startup remains enabled after reopening Settings and rebooting; request the relevant screenshot only if startup still fails.

fix_assessment.rationale: A code fix is not yet applicable to a demonstrated enabled-startup failure: automatic startup being enabled and persisting has not been established. The first discriminator is a setting/behavior confirmation, not a speculative registration fix.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys reportedly does not start in the background after reboot. The report and existing diagnostics do not establish a failure while automatic startup remains enabled, so a short before/after setting confirmation is needed.
known_information: PowerToys 0.101.2362 from Microsoft Store and Windows 11 x64 are specified.
The reporter already supplied a diagnostic ZIP; there are no comments or prior questions.
The issue is open, unassigned and labeled Issue-Bug and Needs-Triage.
No screenshot or explicit enabled-before-reboot confirmation is present in the public report.
inferences: A disabled startup setting could explain the symptom without a code defect.
If startup remains visibly enabled while the application fails to start, task registration or settings persistence becomes a relevant investigation path.
Similar startup reports are not enough to establish that this report has the settings-reset mechanism discussed in #50616.
issue_context.analysis: Ask only for the setting and behavior that distinguish expected disabled-startup behavior from an enabled-startup defect. The existing ZIP should not be requested again. No raw diagnostic settings, logs or private environment details are copied into this candidate.
initial_investigation: Read the complete Japanese body and confirmed there are no comments or linked implementation entries.
Inspected the relevant attached diagnostic settings privately.
Inspected #50379 and #50616 as similar reports; neither establishes matching root cause for this sparse report.
Searched all-state MuyuanMS/PowerToys issues/PRs and matching branch refs for #51385; no matching trace was found.
No reboot or task-registration test was executed locally.

information_gaps.information: Whether enabling General > Run at startup remains enabled after reopening Settings and whether PowerToys starts after the next reboot/sign-in.
information_gaps.why_needed: Distinguishes expected behavior with automatic startup disabled from a setting-persistence or task-registration failure.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Enable Run at startup, reopen Settings to check persistence, then reboot and sign in; report the state and observed startup result.

information_gaps.information: Only if startup still fails: a screenshot of the Run at startup setting after reboot, including any disabled reason or error.
information_gaps.why_needed: Determines whether the UI reports startup enabled, disabled or blocked when the failure occurs.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Upload the relevant Settings screenshot through the GitHub web UI, hiding account names and unrelated personal information.

actions.label: Confirm startup setting persists after reboot

comment.body:
ZIP の添付ありがとうございます。再起動後に起動しないことは分かりましたが、「起動時に実行」が有効なままで起動しないのか、設定自体が無効になっているのかを確認したいです。

1. PowerToys の「全般」で「起動時に実行」をオンにし、設定画面を開き直してもオンのままか確認してください。その後 Windows を再起動してサインインし、自動起動したかと、設定がオンのままかを教えてください。
2. オンのままでも自動起動しない場合のみ、再起動後の該当設定と、表示されるエラーや無効理由のスクリーンショットを GitHub の Web 画面から添付してください。個人情報は隠してください。

同じ ZIP を再提出する必要はありません。

Please confirm whether General > Run at startup stays enabled after reopening Settings and after reboot/sign-in, and whether PowerToys starts automatically. If startup still fails with the setting enabled, please attach a screenshot of that setting and any displayed error or disabled reason, with personal information hidden. This distinguishes disabled automatic startup from a setting-persistence or task-registration failure.
